name: 10594 · Thornwood, NY
findings: ZIP 10594 (Thornwood) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10594 (Thornwood) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
